_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json. ADR-022 consumes docudesk's already-shipped ai-gl-account-suggestion contract over two outbound HTTP requests to docudesk's existing REST endpoints; docudesk never learns a chart of accounts, shillinq supplies its own.
_meta.description: Adds docudeskExtractionId (the financialExtraction id, learned from the synchronous extraction-request response, REQ-GAC-001) and suggestedGlAccount (the cached last-fetched docudesk suggestion, REQ-GAC-003) to SupplierInvoice and Receipt. Also adds glAccount to Receipt (SupplierInvoice already has it) so a receipt draft can carry a booking-account suggestion/selection like a supplier invoice does.

docudeskExtractionId.description: The docudesk `financialExtraction` object id, learned from the synchronous response of DocudeskExtractionClient::requestExtraction() (REQ-GAC-001). Absent when the draft's extraction was never (re-)requested through shillinq's own proxy (e.g. seeded before this change) — the GL-account suggestion feature degrades gracefully to plain manual booking when unset (REQ-GAC-006).
docudeskExtractionId.title: Docudesk Extraction Id

suggestedGlAccount.description: The last-fetched docudesk GL-account suggestion (REQ-GAC-003): {code, label, confidence, rationale, source}. Cached on the draft so the operator's eventual booking choice can be compared against it without a live round-trip. Never auto-applied to glAccount (REQ-GAC-004) — informational only.

example.label: Kantoorkosten
example.rationale: Booked to 4300 in 8 of the last 10 invoices from this supplier

suggestedGlAccount.title: Suggested GL Account

glAccount.description: The grootboekrekening (GL account) code the operator books this receipt to (mirrors SupplierInvoice.glAccount). Opaque string per the chart of accounts (bookkeeping-chart-of-accounts) — never auto-filled from a suggestion without operator confirmation (REQ-GAC-004).
glAccount.title: GL Account
